title: Balance Due After Delivery and the Late Balance Fee — Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Vehicle Purchase Agreements — balance due and late balance fee.**

**1. When the balance is payable.** Any balance due on a delivered deal is payable within the deal type's balance-due days, in calendar days after the delivery date.

**2. When a late balance fee may be assessed.** A late balance fee is assessed only when the handling date is later than the delivery date plus the deal type's late-assessment days. Calendar days are added to the delivery date, which is day 0. The fee can be assessed from the calendar day after that sum, never on the boundary day itself. The evidence is the delivery date on the deal's record.

**3. Fee amount (no longer in force).** The sentence "The fee is the deal type's late balance fee rate per month times the balance due standing at the moment of assessment, rounded to the cent, and never less than the deal type's minimum late balance fee; it is posted under the late balance fee charge with the calendar month of assessment as the billing month" is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for the late balance fee.

**4. One fee per billing month.** A billing month already assessed on a deal is not assessed again.

**5. No fee.** No late balance fee is assessed when the balance due is 0.00 or less, nor on a deal that is unwound, cancelled or closed.

**6. Withdrawn fleet net terms.** A fleet deal whose net terms were withdrawn under the fleet net-terms rule is due on the delivery date. Its late balance fee is assessed after the late-assessment days minus the balance-due days, in calendar days, instead.

## Boundary of clause 2 (hypothetical deal type with 12 late-assessment days, delivered on the 4th of a month)

| Handling date | Fee may be assessed |
|---|---|
| the 16th (delivery date plus 12) | no: this is the boundary day |
| the 17th | yes |

## Clause 4 and 5 checks

| Situation | Assessment |
|---|---|
| a late balance fee is already posted for this billing month | not assessed again |
| balance due 0.00 | not assessed |
| deal closed | not assessed |

superseded_clauses: The fee is late_balance_fee_pct_per_month times the balance_due standing at the moment of assessment, rounded to the cent, and never less than late_balance_min_fee_usd; it is posted under charge_code late_balance_fee with the calendar month of assessment as billing_month.
